name: Mollie for Drupal
description: Enables online payments in Drupal through Mollie.

suggests.webform/webform: Webform should be installed for using the Mollie for Drupal Webform submodule (mollie_webform).

project_description:
This module was officially supported by Mollie until the end of 2023. 

 Mollie will drop support for Drupal integration by the end of 2023 and they will thus stop funding further development for this module. We are currently looking for ways to keep this module maintained and hopefully even develop new features. Let us known if you have funding available or if you have other ideas about funding the maintenance of Mollie for Drupal. 

 With this module enabled site owner can enable customers (more general visitors) to perform payments to the site owners Mollie account . Depending on this Mollie account customers can pay through e.g. iDEAL, Mister Cash, Creditcard, PayPal (see complete list: https://www.mollie.com/en/payments ).

 You will need a Mollie account to use this module.

 Back to top 

 Versions 
 2.x 
 Version 2.x is de recommended version at the time of writing. Use version 2.2.1 or newer (see https://www.drupal.org/sa-contrib-2023-052 ).

 3.x 
 Update 2026/05 : Work has started again on 3.x, we'll try to release a new version as soon as possible.

 We had published a 3.x-dev version for a short period of time. But it is not recommended to use this version. Use 2.2.1 or newer 2.x releases until a 3.x alpha or beta release is out. This will happen once [#3274375] lands. 

 Back to top 

 Supported payment contexts 
 
 Drupal Commerce 
 Ubercart (deprecated, only reactive support) 
 Webform 
 
 Back to top 

 Included submodules 
 
 Mollie for Drupal Commerce 
 Mollie for Ubercart (deprecated) 
 Mollie for Drupal Webform 
 Mollie for Drupal - Customers API 
 
 Back to top 

 Similar modules 
 This module is the Drupal 8 successor of Mollie Payment . Because the development of the Payment module for Drupal 8 halted for quite some time Mollie and Finlet decided to decouple the Mollie integration for Drupal from the Payment ecosystem.
